newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS 5-MO PROFIT 1.675 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS 5-MO PROFIT 1.675 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard producer Medienos Plaushas said Monday that its net profit for the first five months of this year was 1.675 million litas.
The company's general director, Petras Chesna, also told Reuters that the company's net profit for May was 402,000 litas.
"Last year the profit for the first five months was 1.1 million litas," Chesna added.
Medienos Plaushas posted an audited net profit of 1.7 million litas in 1996 and 830,000 litas for the first quarter of 1997.
The company said last week that it had agreed with the Bank of New York to convert around 30 percent of its current shares into global depository receipts in July.
Medienos Plaushas is one of three corporates listed on the elite official list of the Vilnius bourse and holds around 40 percent of the corrugated cardboard market in the country.
It is the sole producer of egg containers in the Baltic region.
